lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in three distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The highest-intensity maxima are located in the upper-mid region, forming a linear horizontal alignment along the superior carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-flank. These intersections serve as primary anchor nodes within the lateral patterning.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature in the upper third of the flank displays a sharp vertical gradient, with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal aspect and a defined shadow zone immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: A vertical shadow line representing the fifth gill slit is visible at the right-most edge of the main flank pattern, marking the anterior boundary of the observed lateral zone.
